name: plannotator
description: The workspace to stay in the loop and on top of agents - shape, decide, plan, annotate, review code, share with team, and send all feedback to agents with one click.
one_liner: A shared workspace where a team can review, comment on, and approve what AI coding agents are doing, instead of blindly trusting their output.
buyer: An engineering manager overseeing a team that uses multiple AI coding agents who needs visibility and sign-off before changes ship.
business_use_cases: An engineering team uses it as the single inbox where every AI agent's proposed plan or diff lands for human review before merge.
A product manager annotates an AI-generated spec directly and sends feedback straight back to the agent without a developer in the loop.
A dev agency gives clients read-only access to the workspace so they can approve AI-driven work themselves, cutting back-and-forth meetings.

money_ideas.idea: Host a managed team version with per-seat pricing, SSO, and audit trails for companies that don't want to self-host

steal_this: Stand up a hosted multi-tenant version, charge per seat, and market it directly at engineering managers drowning in AI-generated pull requests to review.
